description: React component for the mobile sidebar right menu items in Mattermost, including user status, team management, and external links.

classes.name: MobileSidebarRightItems
classes.description: React component rendering the right sidebar menu with user and team options.

methods.name: onRecentMentionItemClick
methods.description: Handles click on recent mentions menu item, toggling mention search or showing mentions.

methods.name: onShowFlaggedPostItemClick
methods.description: Handles click on flagged posts menu item, showing flagged posts.

methods.name: onLogoutItemClick
methods.description: Handles logout action by emitting logged out event.

methods.name: openCustomStatusModal
methods.description: Opens the custom status modal dialog.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the menu component with various menu items and actions.
